svg.text: FAMILY svc_pvso (svc_hi_dsdv_svc_pvso_entry__t1/t2): p4j ENTRY slice, 64 hcores (2 rows per tile), no provider
cores in the outline (merge/tr/SM live in the svc_prov region beside it); job/q/P.V host endpoint
CHAIN E/N/S/W face lanes -> g_t[k] tile pair-rows k (16 hc) -> SX leaf cluster (centre row) -> faces;
entry: j/q/hw in, P.V pv out on the entry faces (attn_i0/i2, unit_i0)
ROLES tiles->SX: GATHER; SX<->faces: PASS-THROUGH relayed lanes; entry q -> all tiles: BROADCAST
CRIT 1 SX hop budget -> SX centred; 2 tile pair rows k stay together (same tile k)
LAYOUT stock stack (tile0 x2, tile1 x2, SX, tile2 x2, tile3 x2) is already the chain; ring area is the limit:
9 full rows leave no macro-free strip at the S face (attn_i3/attnh/hbm rings ~22k flops)
VERDICT REDESIGN: grow pvso S face +104 um (macro-free landing strip, ~0.15 mm2/type); in-outline fine-tune
arrows: green dashed staging->tr (broadcast), green tr->tile (p2p), orange tile->merge (p.v p2p), red tile->SX (score gather), red dashed SX to and from faces (relayed lanes)
